payload.title: India's Performance in Cricket World Cup Events

sections.heading: Findings
sections.body: India won Cricket World Cup twice (in 1983 and 2011) [E9][E13] India have reached the final of the ICC Cricket World Cup a total of three times, and in 2003 Indian Cricket Team reached the finals but lost to Australia [E10][E14] India had a fantastic run in the group stage of the 2015 World Cup, winning all of their six matches [E11] India had a strong group stage performance, finishing at the top of the table with 15 points from 9 matches [E12] Titles Won: 2 (2007, 2024) [E1], but India has won it thrice in 2007, 2024 and 2026 while also finishing as runners-up in 2014 [E5] Runners-up: 1 (2014), Semi-finals: 2016, 2022, Group Stage Exit: 2021 [E2][E3][E4] In the 2024 edition, India became the first and only team to go undefeated in the entire tournament [E6]

sections.heading: Details
sections.body: India won Cricket World Cup twice (in 1983 and 2011) [E13] India won Cricket World Cup twice (in 1983 and 2011) and in 2003, Indian Cricket Team reached the finals but lost to Australia [E14][E13] India had a fantastic run in the group stage of the 2015 World Cup, winning all of their six matches, and India had a strong group stage performance, finishing at the top of the table with 15 points from 9 matches [E11][E12] Titles Won: 2 (2007, 2024) [E1], but India has won it thrice in 2007, 2024 and 2026 while also finishing as runners-up in 2014 [E5] Runners-up: 1 (2014) [E2] Semi-final appearances came in 2016 and 2022 [E3]. A group-stage exit occurred in 2021 [E4]. In the 2024 edition, India became the first and only team to go undefeated in the entire tournament [E6]

citations.span: The Indian cricket team has won the One-Day International (ODI) World Cup two times.
India won Cricket World Cup twice (in 1983 and 2011).
India have reached the final of the ICC Cricket World Cup a total of three times.
In 2003, Indian Cricket Team reached the finals but lost to Australia.
India had a fantastic run in the group stage of the 2015 World Cup, winning all of their six matches.
India had a strong group stage performance, finishing at the top of the table with 15 points from 9 matches.
India has won it thrice in 2007, 2024 and 2026 while also finishing as runners-up in 2014.
In the 2024 edition, India became the first and only team to go undefeated in the entire tournament.
